title: The vocabulary describes the distribution product section and the predicate phrase
summary: The `@distribution` description now says that a distribution may describe the host plugin product it ships (its optional `product` section, which `ia init --from` and `ia project --product plugin` use), and the `@predicate` description now names the present phrase every predicate declares. The descriptions change in the catalogue `ia vocabulary` and the MCP door serve, in every shipped `LANGUAGE.md` and in the authoring-system reference guides; the authoring-system `SPEC.md` also drops a private planning reference. No schema, record or admission changes, and IA syntax remains 1.0. The twelve native archives take a patch version when the next release selects native versions.
